District- Saharsa

======================================================
 1. ASIM PRAKASH SON OF Shri Jai Prakash Yadav R/o- Professor Colony  W.no-5, Madhepura Ps- madhepura Dist- Madhepura  2. Ashish Prakash son of Shri Jai Prakash Yadav R/o- Professor Colony W.no  5, Madhepura Ps- madhepura Dist- Madhepura  ...
... Peti  Versus
1. The State of Bihar  2. Dezi Kumari wife of Ashish Prakash, D/o- Shiv Kumar Yadav R/o-  Professor Colony W.no-5, Madhepura Ps- madhepura Dist- Madhepura  ... ...

Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Ms. Vaishnavi Singh, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Madhura Nand Jha, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SATYAVRAT VERMA  ORAL ORDER 2 18-12-2023 1.
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned APP for the State.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners after some arguments seeks permission to withdraw the quashing application with respect to the petitioner no.2 Ashish Prakash.
3. Permission is accorded.

4. Issue notice to the opposite party no.2 by both modes i.e. speed post as well as ordinary post with A/D, for which necessary requisites must be filed on or before 05.01.2024, failing which the quashing application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.60313 of 2023(2) dt.18-12-2023 5.
Put up this case on 15.04.2024.

sentences.text: In the meantime, the order dated 24.07.2023 passed by the learned S.D.J.M., Saharsa in Complaint Case No.711/2023, whereby cognizance of offence under sections 498A, 504, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections  of the D.P. Act has been taken, shall remain stayed.
7. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is brother-in-law (Bhaisur) of the O.P. No.2.

It is next submitted that whenever any dispute arises in between the husband and the wife, the entire family members are implicated in a mechanical manner with ornamental, general and omnibus allegations.

(Satyavrat Verma, J) amit/-
